risk_if_not_implemented: Without Security of Personal Data (PD), Personal Data (PD) may be collected, processed, retained or shared without lawful authority or adequate safeguards, harming individuals and exposing the organization to regulatory action. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to R-AC-4, R-EX-5, R-GV-2, R-IP-2, R-IP-3, R-IP-6, and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Physical Crime (MT-5), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Data Privacy Program
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation and operation of data protection controls throughout the data lifecycle to ensure all forms of Personal Data (PD) are processed lawfully, fairly and transparently.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data Privacy Program (PRI-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Security of Personal Data (PD) (PRI-10) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Conformity Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to validate that Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) conform to the organization's security, compliance and/or resilience policies, standards and other applicable requirements.
compensating_control_2.justification: Conformity Monitoring (CPL-05) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Security of Personal Data (PD) (PRI-10) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
